Behind every spectacular cake is a team putting in the hours. Buddy Valastro and the crew at Carlo's Bakery pour their creativity, precision, and hard work into custom cakes designed to make special occasions unforgettable. But the real reward comes when customers finally see the finished creations. Relive the amazing cakes and heartfelt reactions that make these Cake Boss moments so satisfying.
Watch Cake Boss Season 6 Episodes 3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 13, 14 and 19 only on discovery+ India.
